mapper.sql: a.id AS "id", a.company_id AS "company.id", IFNULL(company.name,'') AS "company.name", a.drug_a_name AS "drugAName", a.drug_b_name AS "drugBName", a.severity AS "severity", a.message AS "message", a.remarks AS "remarks", a.create_by AS "createBy", a.create_date AS "createDate", a.update_by AS "updateBy", a.update_date AS "updateDate", a.del_flag AS "delFlag"
LEFT JOIN org_company company ON company.id = a.company_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO drug_interaction_rule( id, company_id, drug_a_name, drug_b_name, severity, message, remarks, create_by, create_date, update_by, update_date, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{company.id}, #{drugAName}, #{drugBName}, #{severity}, #{message}, #{remarks}, #{createBy}, #{createDate}, #{updateBy}, #{updateDate}, #{delFlag} )
mapper.update: UPDATE drug_interaction_rule SET drug_a_name = #{drugAName}, drug_b_name = #{drugBName}, severity = #{severity}, message = #{message}, remarks = #{remarks}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_date = #{updateDate} WHERE id = #{id}
